status: FROZEN_CONTENT: G1-G6 ratified exactly as written (architect ruling F, 2026-10-13). Binding for the opening once committed before opening and cited by sha256 in the LOCKBOX_OPEN decision (protocol §1.2 / §1.4)
supersedes: content 2.0.0 of this file (identical G1-G6, aggregation, metrics and reference values; 2.1.0 adds the r2 candidate identity, the architect rulings and the fail-closed missing-data semantics)
season: 2025-26 (canonical 2026), every game scored under the frozen 2024-25 eligibility rules
checkpoint: T-1h only (prediction cutoff = scheduled tip - 1 h, spec.CUTOFF_RULE); the other four pregame checkpoints are N/A for v1 (ruling E)
procedure: the artifact is loaded, never refit, recalibrated or re-selected (protocol §2.4); the rolling baseline and the participation heuristic are computed by their frozen code with the same inputs
evaluator: cbb_platform/lockbox_runner.py (gates() implements pass_criteria; development reproduction in data/qa/lockbox_runner_validation.json)

scoring_populations.participation: pregame candidates labelled PLAYED (1) or DNP_CONFIRMED (0); UNKNOWN_PARTICIPATION and NOT_ON_ROSTER are excluded and counted (props_v0_participation)
scoring_populations.minutes_and_counts: PLAYED rows with a box row and an available label (props_v0); predictions are conditional on appearance; rows with an unavailable label are excluded and counted

prop_threshold_calibration.descriptive: per target, P(over) vs observed rate, Brier and log loss at the half-lines 0.5 / 1.5 / 2.5 (STL, BLK, FG3M, TOV, AST), 2.5 / 4.5 / 6.5 (REB), 5.5 / 9.5 / 14.5 (PTS); flagged (not failed) when |gap| > 0.02

pricing_integrity: integer-line push = P(Y = L), half-line push = 0

aggregation.per_target: unweighted mean over the scored player-game rows of the 2025-26 season (one row per player-game)
aggregation.aggregate_counts: scored-row-weighted mean over the 7 count targets
aggregation.participation: mean over scored candidates; calibration slope / in-the-large from the logistic recalibration fit of y on logit(p), as in props_v0_participation
aggregation.uncertainty: game-clustered CR1 95 % intervals reported for every gated difference (descriptive; gates use point estimates)

pass_criteria.G1_aggregate: candidate aggregate log score < baseline AND candidate aggregate CRPS < baseline
pass_criteria.G2_per_target: candidate beats baseline on BOTH log score and CRPS for >= 6 of 7 count targets
pass_criteria.G3_minutes: candidate MAE < baseline MAE AND candidate RMSE < baseline RMSE
pass_criteria.G4_participation: candidate Brier < heuristic Brier AND candidate log loss < heuristic log loss
pass_criteria.G6_pricing_integrity: every PMF row sums to 1 within 1e-9, no negative entry, 0 P(over) monotonicity violations, push semantics exact, every fair price finite where 0 < p < 1
pass_criteria.verdict: GO only if G1-G6 all hold; any failure = NO-GO for this frozen candidate, never tuned on (protocol §3)

pass_fail_semantics.comparisons: strict inequalities exactly as written; bounds in G5 are inclusive; G6 'push semantics exact' = integer-line push equals P(Y = L) and P(over) + P(under) + P(push) = 1 within 1e-12, half-line push = 0 exactly
pass_fail_semantics.missing_data: a gated value that cannot be computed (no scored rows, missing, NaN or infinite) FAILS its gate; the verdict is then NO-GO. Rows with an unavailable label are excluded from that metric and counted, never imputed
pass_fail_semantics.no_reinterpretation: no gate may be added, removed, re-weighted or re-thresholded after opening; the verdict is the mechanical output of the evaluator

threshold_basis: G1-G5 carried unchanged from the v1 proposal (fixed from the protocol and the frozen 2023-24 / 2024-25 evidence); G6 restates the development integrity checks; nothing from 2025-26
development_check: on the frozen 2024-25 forward validation the candidate meets G1-G6 (reference values below; reproduced fit-free by the evaluator)

not_applicable_by_ruling.market_benchmark: NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_LOCKBOX_GO_NO_GO (ruling C): no rights-cleared historical CBB player-prop market data exists; none is invented, scraped, synthesized or backfilled. No result may be described as a market or sportsbook comparison
not_applicable_by_ruling.energy_variogram_scores: NOT_APPLICABLE (ruling D): v1 prices marginal player-stat distributions; there is no joint distribution to score
not_applicable_by_ruling.five_pit_checkpoints: NOT_APPLICABLE (ruling E): v1 is scored at the single pregame T-1h cutoff; the five checkpoints are all pregame, and only T-1h exists in the v1 feature store

no_post_open_changes: this file's sha256 is recorded in the readiness record and must be cited in the LOCKBOX_OPEN decision; any change after opening voids the evaluation

frozen_reference_values_2024_25.source: frozen 2024-25 forward validation (evaluation B: fit through 2023-24); final candidate = baseline for every non-STL target, STL = NegBin phi 0.16 (final_prelockbox_validation.json)
